fileNodes.name: DatabaseConnection.java
fileNodes.summary: Lazy-initialized Singleton that loads MySQL credentials from data/db_config.properties and hands out the single shared JDBC connection, reconnecting if it was closed.

fileNodes.name: CaseRNGManager.java
fileNodes.summary: Gacha random number logic: rolls a rarity from a case's weighted odds and then picks a tower of that rarity from the case's pool.

fileNodes.name: Catalog.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable in-memory catalog of every tower type and case, loaded once at startup through TowerDAO and CaseDAO and indexed by tower id.

fileNodes.name: GameSession.java
fileNodes.summary: Central run state holding coins, lives, free cases, inventory copies and placed towers; enforces buying/opening cases, placement spacing, upgrade copy costs, the one-Level-5-per-type rule, and selling/refunds.

fileNodes.name: UpgradeCostTable.java
fileNodes.summary: Static helper that looks up how many duplicate tower copies an upgrade to a given level costs for a rarity, based on GameConfig.

fileNodes.name: CaseDAO.java
fileNodes.summary: Data Access Object that reads the cases table and the case_towers join table, building CaseDef records with their rarity weights and tower pools.

fileNodes.name: TowerDAO.java
fileNodes.summary: Data Access Object that reads all rows of the towers table and maps them to TowerType records including rarity and special effect enums.

fileNodes.name: CaseDef.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable record describing a purchasable case: id, name, coin cost, per-rarity drop weights and the pool of towers it can drop.

fileNodes.name: Rarity.java
fileNodes.summary: Enum of tower rarities (Common to Legendary) carrying display name, UI color and gem count.

fileNodes.name: Special.java
fileNodes.summary: Enum of tower special effects (none, stun, poison, burn, buff, turrets, pierce) as stored in the towers table.

fileNodes.name: TowerType.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable record for one tower blueprint row: name, class, rarity, base stats, special effect parameters, description and sprite path (Type Object pattern).

fileNodes.name: ShopOverlay.java
fileNodes.summary: Swing overlay that renders the case shop over the map with three views: case cards with drop odds, an animated spinning reveal strip, and the result card; delegates the actual purchase and roll to GameSession.

fileNodes.name: GameConfig.java
fileNodes.summary: Gson-deserialized game balance configuration (economy, wave scaling, explicit wave spawn lists) loaded from waves_config.json, with helpers for kill rewards, wave-clear rewards and per-wave enemy health/speed multipliers.

fileNodes.name: GameMap.java
fileNodes.summary: Loads the enemy path polyline from a CSV file and parameterizes positions by distance along the path; also decides where towers may be built by checking clearance from the track, decorative roads and obstacles.

fileNodes.name: RunResult.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable record summarizing a finished run (waves cleared, kills, cases opened, previous best, new-record flag) passed to the results screen.

fileNodes.name: PlayerDAO.java
fileNodes.summary: Data access object for the MySQL players table: looks up profiles by name, creates profiles on first login, and conditionally updates the highest score.

fileNodes.name: Player.java
fileNodes.summary: Simple player profile model holding id, name and highest score (waves cleared).

fileNodes.name: AppController.java
fileNodes.summary: Top-level screen controller that wires the landing, game and results panels into the main frame, lazily loads catalog/config/map data, and handles navigation between screens.

fileNodes.name: GameButton.java
fileNodes.summary: Image-based clickable button component with a builder for size, position and icon, plus hover tracking and drawing.

fileNodes.name: TowerArt.java
fileNodes.summary: Static helper that draws a tower icon from its sprite when available, otherwise a placeholder shape colored by tower class.

fileNodes.name: GamePanel.java
fileNodes.summary: Main gameplay screen: runs a fixed-timestep game loop (1/60 s accumulator with x1/x2/x3 speed, paused while the shop is open), handles mouse/keyboard input for placing, selecting, upgrading and selling towers, renders the map, towers, enemies, effects and HUD, and saves new high scores when the run ends.

fileNodes.name: LandingPanel.java
fileNodes.summary: Landing/menu screen where the player types a name, opens a crate to load or create their profile, and can view help or start a run; drawn from image assets with absolute-positioned buttons.

fileNodes.name: DbCheck.java
fileNodes.summary: Read-only command-line diagnostic that verifies the database connection and PlayerDAO lookups work.

fileNodes.name: SpriteLoader.java
fileNodes.summary: Cached loader for tower sprite images by path, returning null for missing files so placeholder art is drawn instead.

fileNodes.name: Main.java
fileNodes.summary: Application entry point that, on the Swing event thread, creates the MainFrame window, wires up the AppController screen router, and shows the window.

fileNodes.name: MainFrame.java
fileNodes.summary: Fixed-size JFrame window that hosts all game screens in a CardLayout panel sized by Theme and exposes methods to register and switch screens by name.

fileNodes.name: Gfx.java
fileNodes.summary: Static Graphics2D text-drawing helpers for centered text, outlined (stroked) text, and word-wrapping strings to a maximum width, shared by the game UI screens.

fileNodes.name: TextButton.java
fileNodes.summary: Lightweight custom-painted button (not a Swing component) with bounds, hover and enabled state, drawn as a rounded colored box with outlined label text using Palette styling.

fileNodes.name: HelpPanel.java
fileNodes.summary: How-to-Play overlay panel that displays help book image spreads with previous/next arrow buttons and an invisible close hit area, manually laid out relative to the book and swallowing clicks to the game beneath.

fileNodes.name: ResultsPanel.java
fileNodes.summary: End-of-run results screen that paints the menu background, the player's RunResult statistics, and PLAY AGAIN / MENU TextButtons that invoke callbacks supplied by the controller.

fileNodes.name: SidePanel.java
fileNodes.summary: In-game right-hand sidebar that paints the tower inventory cards, selected-tower or placement info, and shop/start-wave/speed/upgrade/sell buttons, routing clicks through an Actions callback interface implemented by GamePanel.

fileNodes.name: Palette.java
fileNodes.summary: Shared color constants for the game visuals (grass, path, panels, cream, good/bad, gold) plus heading and body font helpers backed by FontLoader.

fileNodes.name: Theme.java
fileNodes.summary: Global UI constants defining the content window dimensions, core colors, and title/button fonts loaded via FontLoader.

fileNodes.name: FontLoader.java
fileNodes.summary: Loads the Luckiest Guy TrueType font from assets/fonts once at class init, falling back to SansSerif, and derives sized copies on request.

fileNodes.name: ImageLoader.java
fileNodes.summary: Loads UI images from assets/ui via ImageIO, returning null and logging to stderr when a file cannot be read.

fileNodes.name: GameEngine.java
fileNodes.summary: Core game-loop logic that runs waves, recomputes tower buffs, fires towers, moves enemies, pays kill and wave-clear rewards, and detects game over.

fileNodes.name: VisualEffect.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable-shape, time-limited visual effect (shot line or blast circle) with fade-out, produced by towers and drawn by the game panel.

fileNodes.name: TowerFactory.java
fileNodes.summary: Factory that maps a TowerType's database tower_class string to the matching concrete Tower subclass.

fileNodes.name: Enemy.java
fileNodes.summary: Abstract zombie base class handling path movement, health, rewards, and status effects (stun with immunity window, poison, stacking burn).

fileNodes.name: SingleTargetTower.java
fileNodes.summary: Basic tower that shoots the enemy furthest along the track; its Level 5 passive makes it fire 50% faster.

fileNodes.name: SniperTower.java
fileNodes.summary: Sniper tower that targets the highest-health enemy in range, optionally firing a piercing beam that hits multiple enemies along a line.

fileNodes.name: SplashTower.java
fileNodes.summary: Area-damage tower that blasts the furthest enemy and everything within its splash radius, applying poison or burn depending on its special.

fileNodes.name: SupportTower.java
fileNodes.summary: Multi-role support tower whose special selects behavior: STUN (Policeman stuns everything in range), TURRETS (mini-turrets each hit a different enemy), or BUFF (fire-rate aura for nearby towers).

fileNodes.name: Tower.java
fileNodes.summary: Abstract tower base class implementing the Template Method pattern: a final update() handles cooldown and calls the subclass attack(), plus level multipliers, Level 5 passives, fire-rate buffs and targeting helpers.

fileNodes.name: WaveSpawner.java
fileNodes.summary: Builds a time-stamped spawn queue per wave from JSON config (or a formula for later waves), adds a boss every Nth wave, and releases enemies as time elapses.

fileNodes.name: EnemyFactory.java
fileNodes.summary: Factory that maps an enemy type name to the concrete Enemy subclass, applying wave health/speed scales and kill reward.

fileNodes.name: ArmoredEnemy.java
fileNodes.summary: Slow, tough zombie that takes 30% less damage from every hit by overriding the reduceDamage hook.

fileNodes.name: BasicEnemy.java
fileNodes.summary: Standard baseline zombie with default stats and radius.

fileNodes.name: BossEnemy.java
fileNodes.summary: High-health boss zombie spawned every 10th wave that halves the duration of any stun applied to it.

fileNodes.name: FastEnemy.java
fileNodes.summary: Fast, fragile zombie variant with higher speed and a smaller radius.

fileNodes.summary: CSV list of x,y corner points defining the zombie walking path on map 1, loaded by GameMap.

fileNodes.name: waves_config.json
fileNodes.summary: Tuning config with economy values (starting coins/lives, rewards, kill coins, sell refunds, upgrade copy costs), enemy scaling rules, and the hand-authored first three waves, parsed by GameConfig via Gson.

fileNodes.name: pom.xml
fileNodes.summary: Maven build file for the casestd artifact targeting Java 21 with MySQL Connector/J and Gson dependencies.

fileNodes.name: schema.sql
fileNodes.summary: MySQL schema creating btd_case_db with the rebuildable catalog tables towers, cases, and case_towers plus a persistent players table for highest scores.

fileNodes.name: towers
fileNodes.summary: Master tower catalog storing class, rarity, damage, range, fire rate, splash radius, special effect, and sprite path for each tower.

fileNodes.name: cases
fileNodes.summary: Shop case definitions with cost and per-rarity drop weights constrained to sum to 100.

fileNodes.name: case_towers
fileNodes.summary: Join table mapping each case to the towers in its drop pool, with cascading foreign keys.

fileNodes.name: players
fileNodes.summary: Player profiles keyed by unique name storing the highest score (waves cleared).

fileNodes.name: seed_data.sql
fileNodes.summary: Seed script inserting the placeholder tower catalog, the Standard/Premium/Legendary cases, and their case_towers pools, with comments documenting how effect values map to each special.

fileNodes.name: PROJECT_CONTEXT.md
fileNodes.summary: Handoff document for future AI conversations describing the team, git state, setup steps, what has been built, how the game works, and remaining work.
